commits.subject: coopmwm dense teacher: close r1 confidence, support and receipt blockers

receipt_commit: The separate commit updating T2B_READY.json follows the implementation commit; inspect git log on c4/dense-teacher.

blockers_addressed.fix: Shared fail-closed imitation_eligibility at both trigger_targets and build_dataset. Owner minimum calibrated probability 0.8 cannot be lowered by configuration. R retains its uniform random target and independent choice RNG, but now uses the same T1B/T1C-backed scoring adapter for confidence. Confidence binds the exact target, candidate support and observable state. Missing calibration/provenance, mismatched state/support and unverified none targets are filtered. A bare verified flag cannot bypass the gate: a measured, bound all8 completion must match its target/execution/evidence digest. Full rejected labels and candidate scores remain available to verification and monitoring.
regressions: test_shared_imitation_boundary_below_and_at_owner_threshold: both arms at 0.2, 0.799999, 0.8 and 0.95; both consumers; rejected labels retained for verification
test_missing_or_unbound_calibration_fails_closed_at_both_consumers: both arms, missing confidence/provenance, changed support/state, forged verified flag
test_completed_verification_bypasses_confidence_but_cannot_be_retargeted: both arms, real synthetic all8, target/state tampering
test_invalid_config_refused_even_off: added attempt to lower owner threshold to 0.1

blockers_addressed.fix: None preparation now requires the complete ordered recorded support, one prepared plan per alternative, and separately supplied base schedules. Every plan is independently rebuilt as base plus exact move offsets and its canonical digest checked. The frozen contract records each candidate index, move, execution and plan digest. Binding checks receipt K and the complete ordered hash list against this commitment; consumption checks record support descriptors and per-seed plan identities/completeness. Duplicates remain explicit distinct alternatives: no implicit deduplication and no support inferred from receipt K.
regressions: test_none_freezes_exact_support_before_dispatch_and_rejects_other_support: different depth support, omitted alternative, substituted hash and wrong independent base
test_none_matching_support_frozen_before_real_all8_dispatch: prepare before dispatch, matching-support success, measured supervised none and later plan substitution rejection
Existing missing-measurement and stale-success tests now use explicitly prepared full none support

blockers_addressed.fix: policy_radio is preserved through observable capture, DAgger buffering, stored labels/dataset rows and the planner record. Capture invokes real T1B observable validation, including its planner_policy radio contract, to reject nonlocal membership, out-of-range sensing, extra fields and noncausal frame/intent timestamps instead of storing a global radio board.
regressions: test_actual_t1b_v2v_scoring_capture_and_recorded_replay: B/R x V2V/intent actors, actual committed T1B validation/scoring and T1A moves, exact table replay and dataset preservation

test_radio_capture_rejects_nonlocal_noncausal_and_extra_payload: future frame, extra radio vehicles, sensing-range violation, nonlocal previous commands/noise/intent board, noncausal intent and extra field

integration_dependencies.loading: Tests load only these named sources in memory via git show from this worktree's object database; no sibling worktree is opened.
integration_dependencies.scoring_scope: Actual T1B observation validation and candidate scoring; deterministic injected CPU rollout and calibration callback, not a live fitted WM/calibration model. Assertions retain eight paired samples, complete action profiles and the full 600-second horizon.

blockers_addressed.fix: update_receipt(labels, update, arm) provides a once-bound update/arm learning-monitor payload with attempted, selected, measured, incomplete, eligible and filtered counts, explicit denominators and filtered share, confidence provenance, original teacher target and paired measurement evidence. Accuracy is distinct from completion, replication and flips; empty measured subsets return null. build_dataset can attach this receipt with explicit update/arm fields.
regressions: test_update_receipt_mixed_confidence_incomplete_and_empty_accuracy: both arms, exact counts/denominators, missing measurements, null empty accuracy and update/arm mismatch rejection
test_measured_rejections_are_completed_verification: rejected move is incorrect, measured none is correct, accuracy 1/2, original target and paired advantage evidence retained
test_all8_first_seed_rejected_second_seed_wins_and_none_label: both predictions incorrect, accuracy 0/2 despite measured completion
test_failed_measurements_never_certify_move_or_none: incomplete paired checks excluded from accuracy denominator
Completed-verification and matching-none tests assert accuracy 1/1 and confidence bypass

independent_review.independent_rereview: Not run in this fix session

api.config: split_config and plan_config validate all options even while off and remove teacher keys from the runtime config; make_teacher refuses OFF. dense_teacher_p_star is in [0.8, 1].
api.B_and_R_factory: make_teacher(cfg, planner_kwargs={'rollout': cpu_rollout, 'calibration': fitted, 'config': optional_T1B_Config, 'calibrate': optional_T1C_callback, 'move_api': optional_T1A_api}). R sets dense_teacher_random=True and now accepts/requires the SAME calibrated scoring path. Injectable scorer/moves stubs are for CPU contracts only.
api.scoring: planner_scorer forwards the exact recorded support into planner_online.score_moves and maps p_calibrated/expected_gain to the teacher ABI. It preserves policy_radio and does not change horizon or paired WM sample count. Explicit rollout and calibration are mandatory.
api.capture: DAggerBuffer(cadence_s).add(episode, step, t_s, cav, obs_state, candidates=recorded_table), then buffer.label(teacher). teacher.label_state accepts the same table directly. Radio-bearing captures require T1B validation dependencies.
api.eligibility: imitation_eligibility(label) -> eligible, reason, p_calibrated, provenance, verified_bypass. Unverified none is an abstention. Completed correctly bound all8 labels bypass confidence for both arms. Existing incomplete/legacy bindings without exact support/measurement contracts cannot bypass.
api.CE: trigger_targets(labels, batch) requires exact recorded support/masks and eligibility for every row. It raises on a filtered row: T2C must subset learner rows/tables/masks to eligible examples before calling CE. No ignore sentinel that could accidentally train class zero is emitted.
api.datasets: build_dataset(labels, encoder, *, update=None, arm=None) exports only eligible targets, retaining ALL original labels, scores and verification evidence under labels. update and arm must be supplied together to attach the learning-monitor receipt. Standalone datasets explicitly carry null update/arm. save_dataset/load_dataset retain canonical content sealing.
api.verification_selection: select_for_verification(labels, fraction) samples all label identities independently of eligibility; filtered examples remain eligible for spot checks.
api.move_preparation: prepare_verification_plan(label, snapshot, base_profile, *, moves_mod=None, plan_id=None) freezes exact snapshot, independent base schedule and base-plus-offset execution, returning a normal all8 absolute-profile plan.
api.none_preparation: prepare_verification_plan(none_label, snapshot, moves_mod=api, candidate_plans=ordered_plans, candidate_base_profiles=independent_bases) must run BEFORE dispatch. Each recorded non-none alternative needs one plan and independently supplied member-by-second base schedule, in exact recorded order; duplicate moves still get distinct plan identities. Returns None for policy-continues and freezes every alternative's execution/digest mapping. Missing, changed or substituted alternatives are refused.
api.verification_dispatch: verify_selected(labels, fraction, submit_first_seed, verifier, *, recover_incomplete=None) uses existing all8 machinery. submit_first_seed returns (sealed_receipt, index, plan), with None/None for a none target after preparing its full support. Existing explicit fresh-id recovery and failure history remain supported.
api.verification_consumption: All8Verifier.flush delegates to confirm_pending_all8. consume requires measured paired branches on both required seeds, checks plan/support identities and recomputes completion, accuracy and the completion digest. A measured statistical rejection is completed, but not an accurate positive prediction. Missing measurements remain incomplete.
api.learning_monitor: update_receipt(labels, update, arm) -> coopmwm/dense-update/v1. B requires wm sources and R random sources; labels cannot migrate between updates/arms. counts exposes attempted/selected/measured/incomplete/eligible/filtered and accuracy_correct/accuracy_measured; top-level filtered_denominator, filtered_share, accuracy_numerator, accuracy_denominator and label_accuracy are explicit. Per-label rows preserve original_teacher_target, candidate class, confidence provenance, measurement completeness/correctness, receipt/execution hashes and paired evidence. T2C owns writing the monitor.
api.budget: verification_quote retains existing quote_decision upper-bound arithmetic, including all candidates, required seeds, solos and registered extra seeds.

accuracy_definition.positive_move: Correct iff the original selected move is admitted by existing all8 lower95/safety/later-harm rules on BOTH required CRN seeds 1 and 2.
accuracy_definition.none: Correct iff its ENTIRE frozen support is measured on both required seeds and no alternative is admitted on either required seed.
accuracy_definition.missing: Incomplete paired evidence is excluded from the accuracy denominator, never counted as measured incorrect or fabricated correct.
accuracy_definition.empty: label_accuracy is null when accuracy_denominator is zero; filtered_share is null when attempted is zero.
accuracy_definition.targets: Original teacher targets are preserved rather than silently rewritten after checking; correctness is reported separately from completed-verification confidence bypass.
